comparison.objective: Assemble a modular hooked retrieval tool and use it to pull a cartridge into a tray; candidate uses a dedicated tool to depin a contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a release, align and quarter-turn-lock a tool head, then hook and pull a cartridge versus dual-blade insertion, two-tang depression, and wire push-then-pull coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the cartridge retrieved and the assembled tool returned intact and locked; candidate requires selective terminal exit without neighbor release or housing/crimp damage. Candidate force thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Despite tool-mediated release and pulling, the retrieval task tests tool assembly and hook engagement rather than recessed connector-tang release.
